title: Chicken and vegetables au gratin with rice, diet frozen entree

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken and vegetables au gratin with rice is a diet frozen entree designed for quick and convenient preparation. It contains tender chicken breast, a mix of carrots, broccoli and cauliflower, topped with a light cheese crust, and served with steamed rice.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is produced by a company with over 30 years of experience in frozen foods.
The cheese crust is made from reduced‑fat cheese, lowering calories without sacrificing flavor.
The rice used is whole‑grain, providing longer lasting satiety.
Each serving provides approximately 250 kcal, making it suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.
The product has been tested for flavor and texture retention after freezing and microwave reheating.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Chicken supplies high‑quality protein essential for maintaining muscle mass.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Reduced‑fat cheese and chicken breast keep the dish low in fat, suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vegetables and chicken provide vitamins B6 and B12, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Fiber
items.content: Vegetables and whole‑grain rice add dietary fiber, promoting healthy digestion.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The meal contains potassium, magnesium and iron, important for muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cheese crust may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to milk proteins.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: People monitoring salt intake should note the moderate sodium level in the dish.

items.title: Heating requirements
items.content: Improper reheating can lead to uneven heating and loss of flavor.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Microwave the frozen entree on high for 3–4 minutes, or bake in a preheated oven at 180 °C for 12–15 minutes until the crust turns golden. Stir before serving to evenly distribute the sauce and rice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen product at –18 °C or lower. Once the package is opened, use within 24 hours if the product has been thawed.
